theory.title: Exercise 2.1.2: Suite Setup & Teardown
theory.content:
🔌 Power Up, Test, Power Down

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, imagine our ship's diagnostic system. Before running ANY tests, we need to power up subsystems. After ALL tests finish, we shut down safely."

"Suite Setup runs once before all tests. Suite Teardown runs once after all tests. No matter if you have 1 test or 100 tests - these run exactly once per suite."

⚙️ What are Suite Hooks?

Suite Setup - Runs ONCE before the first test in the suite

  • ✅ Initialize databases or connections
  • ✅ Power up test environments
  • ✅ Load configuration files
  • ✅ Create test data

Suite Teardown - Runs ONCE after the last test in the suite

  • ✅ Close database connections
  • ✅ Clean up test data
  • ✅ Power down systems
  • ✅ Generate reports

📝 Suite Lifecycle Example

*** Settings ***
Suite Setup      Log    Powering up diagnostic systems
Suite Teardown   Log    Shutting down all systems

*** Test Cases ***
Test 1
    Log    Running first test

Test 2
    Log    Running second test

Execution Order:

  1. 🔹 Suite Setup runs: "Powering up diagnostic systems"
  2. 🔹 Test 1 runs: "Running first test"
  3. 🔹 Test 2 runs: "Running second test"
  4. 🔹 Suite Teardown runs: "Shutting down all systems"

📋 Suite Hooks Rules

  • 🔹 Frequency: Run exactly ONCE per suite execution
  • 🔹 Syntax: Suite Setup Keyword Arguments
  • 🔹 Position: Declared in *** Settings *** section
  • 🔹 Failure Handling: If Suite Setup fails, NO tests run
  • 🔹 Teardown Guarantee: Suite Teardown runs even if tests fail

🎯 Your Task

Create a suite with both Suite Setup and Suite Teardown. Watch the execution order in the log - you'll see the setup run first, then your test, then the teardown last.
